title: Live music to raise cash for Christmas dinners
summary: A live music event is raising funds to help financially struggling families in the South East afford Christmas dinners. The charity event combines entertainment with financial support for vulnerable households during the holiday season.
content: Proceeds from the event help fund Christmas for families struggling financially in the South East.

zh.title: 现场音乐筹集圣诞晚餐资金
zh.summary: 一场现场音乐活动正在筹集资金，帮助东南部财务困难的家庭承担圣诞晚餐费用。这场慈善活动将娱乐与对脆弱家庭假期期间的财务支持相结合。

title: From Trump’s takeover threats to a ‘northern neighborhood,’ why the EU chief is going to Greenland
summary: The EU chief is visiting Greenland amid renewed U.S. pressure under Trump to gain greater control over the self-governing Danish territory. The visit reflects escalating tensions over strategic Arctic interests and territorial influence.
content: The visit comes as Trump renews his push for greater U.S. control of the self-governing Danish territory.

zh.title: 从特朗普接管威胁到"北方邻域"，欧盟首脑为何要前往格陵兰
zh.summary: 在特朗普政府下美国重新施压以获得对自治丹麦领土更大控制权之际，欧盟首脑正访问格陵兰。该访问反映了在战略北极利益和领土影响力上日益升级的紧张局势。

title: How much can Canada fight back in its trade war with the US?
summary: Canada faces escalating trade tensions with the US, though analysts suggest the country shouldn't be underestimated in the conflict despite the US being the larger trading partner.
content: The US may be the bigger trading partner, but Canada shouldn't be counted out quite yet in the escalating trade fight.

zh.title: 加拿大能在与美国的贸易战中反击多少?
zh.summary: 加拿大面临与美国升级的贸易紧张局势,尽管美国是更大的贸易伙伴,但分析人士认为加拿大在这场冲突中不应被低估。

title: Flight price rises due to 'foolish leaders' starting wars, Virgin's Branson says
summary: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East have disrupted oil production and transportation, causing significant increases in jet and vehicle fuel prices.
content: Middle East tensions have choked the production and transportation of oil, causing a surge in the price of car and jet fuels.

zh.title: 维珍集团布兰森表示航班价格上升是由于'愚蠢的领导人'发动战争
zh.summary: 中东地缘政治紧张局势扰乱了石油生产和运输,导致喷气燃料和车用燃料价格大幅上涨。
